name: Pipeliners - Indexing Report 2026-09-28
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-09-28

# Summary
Indexing triage for the not-indexed pages as of Sep 28, 2026: a prioritized tracker, a six-page diagnosis and a merge proposal. Ad exposure was checked first (Google Ads landing_page_view, customer 7219095860, Jun 30 to Sep 27).

# Key findings
- Tracker (`indexing-tracker.csv`): 10 pages prioritized. Request indexing for /leak-detection-services-in-phoenix-arizona/ (never seen by Google, rewritten Sep 26), /when-is-pipe-descaling-necessary/, /top-10-signs.../, /understanding-pipe-restoration-repiping-vs-pipelining/ and the two myths posts. Content first for the trenchless lining cost post and the residential restoration guide. Ask Kim for /pipelining/ (paid LP, 771 impressions and 38 clicks) and /pipeline-locating.../ (pMax 39 impressions).
- /pipeline-environmental-compliance-arizona/ is indexed but a live 404 and still getting pMax impressions (flag).
- Five pages fixed by the Sep 22 requests (for example /2024-homeowners-plumbing-guide/, /are-your-pipes-due-for-a-checkup/).
- Six-page diagnosis: causes are crawl timing, generic 2025 bulk-import text, crowded "signs" and "relining" clusters, thin myths posts, and zero in-content links.

# Decisions and status
- Merge plan (proposal only): top-10 signs into /5-signs-you-need-to-repipe-your-home-in-arizona/ (move only the missing signs, 301), and the residential restoration guide into the repiping vs relining post (held for Scott since Sep 22).
- Myths pair left alone (one ran ads; Kim hold Sep 22). Ad-touched pages ruled out as merge destinations.

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `indexing-tracker.csv`, `six-page-diagnosis.csv`, `merge-plan.md`.
